findings.title: 42 services have your email address
findings.detail: Found from signup, password-reset, receipt and security emails. 42 appear only once - likely forgotten accounts.

steps: Open the evidence list and pick accounts you no longer use
Log in to each service > Settings > Account > Delete account
No delete option: email the service's privacy contact asking for erasure under India's DPDP Act 2023
Change reused passwords on the services you keep

findings.title: 6 sites may use session-recording tools (cookie indicators)
findings.detail: Cookie names associated with 4 distinct vendors (FullStory, Hotjar, LogRocket, Microsoft Clarity) appear for 6 distinct sites. This indicates a site may use session-recording tools; it does not prove clicks, typing or screen contents were recorded or transmitted.

steps: Install uBlock Origin and enable the 'EasyPrivacy' filter list
Chrome > Settings > Privacy and security > Third-party cookies > Block third-party cookies
Delete existing data: Settings > Privacy > Delete browsing data > Cookies

findings.title: 6 sites can access your location, camera or microphone
findings.detail: 4 location, 2 camera, 1 microphone permissions are allowed in your browser.

steps: Chrome > Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings
Open Location, Camera and Microphone; remove every site you don't trust
Set the default to 'Don't allow sites to ...'

findings.title: 4 apps accessed your location in the last 7 days
findings.detail: Observed access events across iOS and Android. The same app on two platforms counts as two app installations; permission alone does not prove use.

steps: iPhone: Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > select the app
Choose Never or While Using the App; turn off Precise Location where unnecessary
Android: Settings > Privacy > Permission manager > Location > select the app
Choose Don't allow or Allow only while using the app; turn off precise location

findings.title: 3 apps are connected to your Google account
findings.detail: Google security emails show these apps got access: Canva, QuizMaster Pro, Truecaller. Connected apps can keep reading your profile, email or contacts until removed.

steps: Open myaccount.google.com/connections
Review 'Third-party apps and services'
Click each app you don't use > Delete all connections

findings.title: 3 apps send data to session-recording or tracking services
findings.detail: App Privacy Report shows connections to known tracking or session-recording domains. A connection alone does not prove that screen contents were recorded.

steps: iPhone: Settings > Privacy & Security > App Privacy Report
Open App Network Activity > select an app > review the listed domains
Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking > turn off Allow Apps to Request to Track
Review the app's privacy settings; uninstall apps whose data sharing you do not accept
